errors.business_issue: Operating income was not reduced by tax in the forecast years
errors.effect: MAX with pretax EBIT makes NOPAT equal to pretax EBIT when earnings are positive; affects FCFF, present values and equity.

errors.business_issue: Terminal reinvestment uses an incorrect sales-to-capital relation
errors.source_method: Stable reinvestment equals stable growth divided by terminal return on capital, times terminal NOPAT.

errors.business_issue: Terminal value discounted one additional year
errors.source_method: The terminal value at endyear10 uses the10-year cumulative discount factor.

errors.business_issue: Debt bridge omits capitalized operating leases
errors.clarification: The referenced amount is actual book debt; its equality to the cash amount is coincidental.
